claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-assisted access that reveals a whistleblower reporter's identity or identifying content (a read, an unmasking, a routing that reveals the reporter, an export) MUST map to a recorded need-to-know named-authority decision — the agent, the report artefact, the intended access, and the named case-handler / ethics officer under whose authority and need-to-know it proceeds. Accesses lacking a recorded need-to-know authority decision are refused at the action-admissibility gate.

Every reporter-identifying access and every consequential case action MUST emit a signed, replay-provable confidentiality Evidence Pack binding the need-to-know named-authority decision, the data-minimisation basis (what identifying fields were exposed and why), the accessing principal, and the access purpose under a context seal — reconstructable and valid at T=0, derivable from published keys alone, retained under WORM — the defensibility artefact a regulator, a court, or the reporter can verify offline when confidentiality is challenged.

Before any adverse HR / employment action that touches a known reporter — a termination, demotion, reassignment, discipline, performance-rating change, or denial of benefit affecting a person who made a protected disclosure — proceeds, a retaliation-risk assessment MUST be recorded as evidence (the reporter's protected-disclosure status, the proximity in time and decision-maker to the disclosure, the stated non-retaliatory basis, and the named assessing authority), so the anti-retaliation protections of SOX §806, Dodd-Frank, UK PIDA, and the EU Whistleblower Directive Art. 19 are defensible and the burden-of-proof record exists if challenged.

Every AI-assisted case disposition (close / dismiss / escalate / refer externally / substantiate) MUST map to a recorded named-authority decision — the agent, the case artefact, the intended disposition, and the named case-handler / ethics officer / disclosure-receiver under whose authority it proceeds — so the acknowledgement / feedback-clock and reasonable-follow-up obligations of the EU Whistleblower Directive Art. 9 / 11 and UK PIDA are met under a named, accountable authority.

Every AI-assisted whistleblower / speak-up determination that proceeds to a consequential action MUST carry a contestability record — a stable determination identifier, the inputs and authority and evidence it rested on, and a reconstruction / challenge route — so that when the determination is challenged (a reporter alleging retaliation under SOX §806 / Dodd-Frank / UK PIDA, a confidentiality-breach complaint under the EU Whistleblower Directive Art. 16, a GDPR data-subject access or objection, a regulator inquiry) it can be reconstructed exactly as made and contested through a recorded route.

KYE governs the AUTHORITY + EVIDENCE + DEFENSIBILITY of AI-assisted whistleblower intake / triage / case-handling and PROVES it — who/what may access a report, who authorised closing or escalating, whether a retaliation-risk record exists before adverse action on a reporter, and whether any determination can be reconstructed and contested. KYE does NOT investigate the substance, judge the allegation, decide whether wrongdoing occurred, render the ethics opinion, or replace the ethics / legal / compliance officer.
